scope: Four reader rules; host179 build is separately authorized, not released by this plugin repository.

candidates.requirements: Generic JS host with public imageHeaders; no native gateway
candidates.evidence: Unchanged rule has real iOS discover/search20/24 and synthetic content contracts; actual upstream images are not validated.
candidates.readingRepair: Decode inert document.writeln string data, scan balanced imglist array ignoring brackets in captions; preserve all ordered pages. No eval or site script execution.

candidates.requirements: Generic JS host with public imageHeaders; resolves direct image URLs in script
limitations: Selected gallery only; gallery versions are separate items
Ten image pages per chapter to bound work within the existing runtime budget
Full thumbnail collection capped at100 pages/5000 images; no login, ExHentai, quota or verification bypass
Expiring CDN image URLs require refreshing the chapter
candidates.evidence: Generic-host installation and synthetic ordered image resolution tests; changed rule is not claimed real iOS/live-image accepted.
candidates.readingRepair: Accept valid HTTPS ports on .hath.network image nodes only; preserve TLS checks and rejection of credentials/private hosts/quotas/challenges. Native host179 resolver requires the matching application repair.

candidates.requirements: Native JmcomicClient API decryption and binary JM image restoration. Requires Triomi app commit 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2 or a compatible successor; official iOS178 commit 0c27925 is unsupported. Same version label 0.12.0+178 is insufficient.
candidates.evidence: Existing native production contracts and iOS candidate evidence are separate from catalog installation. No real Pica account acceptance; no real JM image acceptance claimed.

candidates.requirements: Native PicacomicJsSource secure account/signing gateway and system secure storage. Requires Triomi iOS181 (0.12.0+181) or a successor declaring picacomic.account.v3, which sends the reference protocol empty Authorization header on sign-in and safely classifies HTTP 400 responses. Host179/180 are unsupported by rule 1.0.4. Initial native implementation: 67ce2cd4b9b9c0a87dcf556d0eb3aa9951634da2. Legacy clients ignore requiresHost; update the application before installing this rule. Rule 1.0.4 only fixes single-page catalog pagination; full episode/image traversal retains the 200-page and 20,000-item budgets. Authorized account acceptance through host181 production login and category path passed; real JS catalog, detail, images and reading remain unverified.
candidates.evidence: Two independent reference implementations send an empty Authorization header on sign-in; the host aligns this protocol difference and safely classifies HTTP 400 failures. An isolated production-JS VM replay reproduced a >200-page catalog rejection and passed after separating single-page structure validation from the full-traversal budget. This synthetic replay is not a real upstream catalog/image acceptance. One authorized account login and authenticated category request passed through the host181 production code; credentials and tokens were cleared and are not recorded.

enforcement: Legacy clients ignore hostRequirements and requiresHost; installation is NOT prevented on these clients and does not add missing native support. Host179 and successors enforce structured requiresHost before installation/import/loading. Pica 1.0.4 requires account.v3 (iOS181) and is rejected by 179/180; update the application first. Capability declarations do not grant native authority. See the application Release for actual build/acceptance status.
